# OpenCodeUpdater

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.OpenCode` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/OpenCode/OpenCodeUpdater.cs#L23)

Checks for and installs newer opencode releases.
The framework's setup installs opencode once and never again, and opencode ships fixes
weekly - including ones the window depends on (1.18.12 had OpenCode Zen's free models refuse
the compaction step with "free tier can only be used from within OpenCode"). So the window
compares versions and offers the update itself.
The server must be stopped first: on Windows a running executable cannot be replaced, which
is also why opencode's own "upgrade" command is not used - it would be replacing itself.
Instead the update goes through whatever put the binary there: npm for an npm install, the
framework's installer for one in ~/.opencode/bin, and opencode's upgrade command only as a
last resort for anything else.

### Update() {#update}
